teles.translation: abbr. 台湾地震损失评估系统（Taiwan Earthquake Loss Evaluation System）

telesale.translation: n. 电话销售,电话售货

telesales.translation: (telesale 的复数) n.电话销售,电话售货

telesaling.translation: (telesale 的现在分词) n.电话销售,电话售货

telescope.definition:
n. a magnifier of images of distant objects
v. crush together or collapse
v. make smaller or shorter
telescope.translation:
n. 望远镜
vi. 叠缩, 嵌进, 缩短
vt. 使叠缩, 使缩短

telescope sight.translation: [体]光学瞄准具; 望远镜式瞄准器

telescoped.translation: 错开的; 窜边的; 套叠的

telescopes.definition:
n a magnifier of images of distant objects
v crush together or collapse
v make smaller or shorter
telescopes.translation: n. 望远镜( telescope的名词复数 )

telescopic.definition:
s. visible only with a telescope
s. capable of discerning distant objects
s. having parts that slide one within another
telescopic.translation:
a. 望远镜的, 用望远镜看到的, 套管式的, 伸缩的
[医] 望远[镜]的

telescopical.definition:
a. Of or pertaining to a telescope; performed by a
   telescope.
a. Seen or discoverable only by a telescope; as,
   telescopic stars.
a. Able to discern objects at a distance; farseeing;
   far-reaching; as, a telescopic eye; telescopic vision.
a. Having the power of extension by joints sliding one
   within another, like the tube of a small telescope or a spyglass;
   especially (Mach.), constructed of concentric tubes, either stationary,
   as in the telescopic boiler, or movable, as in the telescopic chimney
   of a war vessel, which may be put out of sight by being lowered
   endwise.
telescopical.translation: a. (=telescopic)望远镜的, 用望远镜看的

telescopically.translation: adv. 望远镜地, 伸缩地

telescopiform.translation: a. 望远镜形的, 套迭的, 可伸缩的

telescoping.definition:
v crush together or collapse
v make smaller or shorter

telescopist.definition: n. One who uses a telescope.
telescopist.translation: n. 使用望远镜的人, 用望远镜观测者

telescopium.definition: n a small constellation in the southern hemisphere near Ara

telescopy.definition: n. the art of making and using telescopes
telescopy.translation: n. 望远镜使用(学), 望远镜制造(学)

telescreen.translation: n. 电视屏幕, 荧光屏

telescreens.translation: (telescreen 的复数) n. 电视屏幕, 荧光屏

telescript.translation: n. 电视广播稿, 电视剧本

teleseismology.translation: 遥测地震学, 远震学

teleselling.definition: n the use of the telephone as an interactive medium for promotion and sales

teleseme.translation: n. 用电传唤人的信号装置

teleset.translation: n. 电视机, 电视接收机

teleshop.translation: vi. 用电话(或电视)购物

telesoftware.translation: [计] 远程软件, 电传软件

telespectroscope.definition:
n. A spectroscope arranged to be attached to a
   telescope for observation of distant objects, as the sun or stars.

telespeedometer.translation: 遥测速度计, 远测速度计

telestereoscope.definition:
n. A stereoscope adapted to view distant natural
   objects or landscapes; a telescopic stereoscope.
telestereoscope.translation: n. 双筒立体望远镜, 光学测距仪

telesthesia.translation:
n. 超常知觉, 特异知觉
[医] 思想交通, 思想感应, 传心

telestich.definition:
n. A poem in which the final letters of the lines, taken
   consequently, make a name. Cf. Acrostic.
telestich.translation: n. 各行最后的字母可缀合成一名(或一词)的短诗

teleswitch.translation: n. 遥控键, 遥控开关

telesyn.translation: 远距离自动同步机, 遥控同步器

telesyphilis.translation: 终期梅毒, 四期梅毒
